page_title: MNU 1-0 LUT | Manchester Utd v Luton 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Graham Scott is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' The shot by Teden Mengi (Luton) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Andre Onana.
90+4' Manchester Utd have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
90+3' Tom Lockyer (Luton) gets a yellow card.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
88' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
88' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Elijah Adebayo (Luton) for Issa Kabore.
86' Substitution. Chiedozie Ogbene is replaced by Ryan Giles (Luton).
86' Here is a change. Marvelous Nakamba is going off and Rob Edwards gives the last tactical orders to Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton).
85' Luton are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.

82' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Thomas Kaminski shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
80' The attendance is 73599.
79' That's the end of the game for Sergio Reguilon, who is replaced by Raphael Varane (Manchester United).
79' Erik ten Hag decides to make a substitution. Rasmus Hojlund will be replaced by Anthony Martial (Manchester United).
76' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will take the corner.
76' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The referee signals a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Issa Kabore (Luton) was quite harsh and Graham Scott didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
74' Ross Barkley (Luton) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
73' Luton are awarded a mid-range free kick.
73' Alfie Doughty (Luton) is being substituted because of an injury. Rob Edwards sends Jordan Clark on the pitch.
72' Alfie Doughty (Luton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

70' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Thomas Kaminski is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.
68' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
68' It will be a substitution. Antony (Manchester United) is ready to enter the pitch as Alejandro Garnacho walks off.
68' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd win a corner kick.
67' Ross Barkley (Luton) takes a snap shot on the edge of the box, but it sails well wide of the right post.

65' Tahith Chong (Luton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Graham Scott with no other option than to blow for a foul.
63' Alfie Doughty (Luton) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tahith Chong (Luton) comes onto the pitch for Andros Townsend.
59' 1 - 0 Goal! Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 1:0.
59' The corner is swung in but Manchester Utd can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
58' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) serves up a nice cross, but Thomas Kaminski punches the ball away.
55' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) makes a strong challenge and Graham Scott blows for a foul.
52' Wasted effort! Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
50' Andros Townsend (Luton) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.

49' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches wide of the left-hand post.
48' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
47' Graham Scott blows his whistle and signals a foul after Issa Kabore (Luton) brought his opponent down.
46' Graham Scott blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Issa Kabore (Luton) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Mason Mount (Manchester United) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
42' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Scott McTominay (Manchester United) but poses no threat.

41' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Thomas Kaminski to get hold of the ball.
40' Christian Eriksen is substituted due to injury. Erik ten Hag gives a chance to Mason Mount (Manchester United).
39' The game is interrupted now, Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
37' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.

36' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Andre Onana dived superbly to block a header by Carlton Morris (Luton) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the right post, but Andre Onana pulled off a remarkable save!
35' Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United) commits a foul and Graham Scott immediately signals a free kick.
35' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
33' Graham Scott blows his whistle as Carlton Morris (Luton) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
31' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
31' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
31' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

31' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner.
29' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
28' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
25' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
24' Alejandro Garnacho races towards the box before laying off to Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
23' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
22' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Andre Onana easily catches the ball.
20' The opposition back off Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies over the bar. Unlucky!
19' Andros Townsend (Luton) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
19' Teden Mengi (Luton) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Luton win a corner.

16' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Scott McTominay (Manchester United) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
15' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
12' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' A clumsy foul by Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) and Graham Scott blows his whistle.
10' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) races onto a cross inside the box and lets fly with a powerful effort, but Thomas Kaminski makes a fantastic reaction save to deny him.
9' A lofted cross from Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
7' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
4' The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner.
4' Manchester Utd seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
